name: pig_slurry_5

source.dm_frac: [C] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a code 21.
source.density_kg_m3: [AS] recalled, no density was found in the tables.
source.n_total_kg_t: [D] LfL Bayern, Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstoffflusse Bas22 (12/2021) Tab. 3 / 5a code 21, 5.7 kg N per m3, divided by the density.

source.k_vol_per_day: [D] volatilisation share of the surface ammoniacal N k_vol / (k_vol + k_inf) from the broadcast emission factor, at the total rate fitted to the UBA incorporation-time reductions (docs/data_formats/field_material.md), 15 degC.
source.k_inf_per_mm_rain: [AS] extra infiltration rate per mm of rain that day (the Guidebook only says that rain has a significant effect on the fertiliser emission factor).
source.org_slow_fraction: [AS] share of the organic N entering the slow humus pool, the rest the fresh pool.

source: Fattening-pig slurry, 5 % dry matter (LfL code 21). Emission factor 0.40 of the ammoniacal N when broadcast (EMEP 3.B Table 3-9, finishing pigs).
